name: Sharpshooter
summary: +1 Dex; ranged weapon attacks ignore Half and Three-Quarters Cover, nearby enemies and long range penalties.

benefits.name: Bypass Cover
benefits.summary: Your ranged weapon attacks ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.
benefits.text: Your ranged attacks with weapons ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover.

benefits.name: Firing in Melee
benefits.summary: An enemy within 5 feet doesn't give you Disadvantage on Ranged weapon attack rolls.
benefits.text: Being within 5 feet of an enemy doesn't impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with Ranged weapons.

benefits.name: Long Shots
benefits.summary: Attacking at long range doesn't give Disadvantage with Ranged weapons.
benefits.text: Attacking at long range doesn't impose Disadvantage on your attack rolls with Ranged weapons.
